name: AI Usage Meter
author: Rivo Agency
description: Your AI coding limits on Stream Deck, for Claude, Codex and Kimi Code. Claude: 5-hour and weekly plan limits for every model, peak hours, cloud and API credit, tokens and API-equivalent cost of Claude Code, cache hits, model mix, session context, streak, status. Codex: 5-hour and weekly limits, credits, tokens, cost, cache, models, status. Kimi Code: 5-hour, weekly and monthly limits, extra usage, status. Plus one key with all three, and keys that start each tool. Unofficial; not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI or Moonshot AI.
